recognize_zh: 中央一顆中性球細胞質內有數個清楚空泡，其中含淡紫色顆粒狀物，大小與血小板相當，代表吞噬血小板；背景可見少數棘狀紅血球與游離血小板。
features: Neutrophil with lobulated dark nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm
Two to three well-defined cytoplasmic vacuoles, one containing a pale granular platelet-sized body
Background normochromic red cells with occasional echinocytes
Few free platelets and small platelet clumps in the field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with scattered echinocytes and a few small platelet clumps. A neutrophil contains several sharply defined phagocytic vacuoles indenting the nucleus, at least one of which encloses a pale granular body consistent with an ingested platelet. Findings are consistent with neutrophil phagocytosis of platelets.

ddx.vs: Toxic vacuoles are multiple small empty vacuoles often with toxic granulation, whereas these vacuoles contain platelet-like material.
Histoplasma yeasts are uniform 2–4 µm oval bodies with a crescent of purple chromatin and a clear halo, not pale granular platelet fragments.
Satellitism places platelets around the outside of the neutrophil membrane rather than within vacuoles.
